slot.brief: Given a complex number in x+iy form, compute |z| and z̄, then evaluate an expression like z·z̄ or z/z̄ as a+ib.

stem: For $z=-2+3i$, evaluate $\dfrac{1}{z}+\dfrac{z}{\bar z}$ in the form $a+ib$.
working:
$\bar z=-2-3i,\quad |z|^2=13,\quad \dfrac1z=\dfrac{-2-3i}{13}$.
$\dfrac{z}{\bar z}=\dfrac{(-2+3i)^2}{13}=\dfrac{-5-12i}{13}$.
$\dfrac1z+\dfrac{z}{\bar z}=\dfrac{-7-15i}{13}$. Independent check: \(1/z=(-2-3i)/13\) and \(z/\bar z=(-5-12i)/13\). Their sum is \((-7-15i)/13\).

draft.stem: For $z=-2+3i$, evaluate $\dfrac{1}{z}+\dfrac{z}{\bar z}$ in the form $a+ib$.

B: Reverses the sign of the imaginary part.
